requirements.desc: R1: stdin-fallback EPIPE/ENOTCONN captured as retryable
requirements.note: In `src/lib/agent.js`, stdin fallback now attaches `child.stdin` error handling, captures write errors (`stdinError`), avoids process crash, and surfaces them as call errors eligible for retry.

requirements.desc: R2: runText returns errors, CLI dispatcher sets exit code
requirements.note: `runText` no longer sets `process.exitCode`; `DocsTextCommand.execute` now throws an Error with `exitCode = 1`, `agentError = true`, and failure data when per-file errors exist.

`src/lib/agent.js` adds `DEFAULT_RETRY_COUNT = 2`, preserves override precedence (`options` > `config` > default), and implements exponential delay (`retryDelayMs * 2^attempt`) with existing max clamp.

Empty responses and non-zero exits continue to be surfaced as retryable failures; stdin-write failures are now surfaced similarly; timeout remains terminal via `killed`/`SIGTERM` path and no-retry behavior.

requirements.desc: R5: acceptance harness classifies agent-error distinctly; remove prevExitCode workaround
requirements.note: `tests/acceptance/lib/pipeline.js` adds `agent-error` classification (including `agentError` marker), continues pipeline for text on agent infra failures, and removes `prevExitCode` save/restore logic.

requirements.desc: R6: deterministic agent stub for empty/stdin-fail/timeout/non-zero-exit
requirements.note: Failure-path tests were added/updated, but this diff does not show a new dedicated configurable stub infrastructure; tests mainly simulate behavior via spawned `node -e` processes and existing seams.

unplanned.change: Project config now sets `agent.retryCount` to 2; this is a project-level default change beyond the stated library-level default requirement.
Large addition of spec/process artifacts (`draft.md`, `flow.json`, `issue-log.json`, `qa.md`, `spec.md`, spec-local tests) not directly part of runtime requirement implementation.

summary.notes: R1-R5 are implemented in code changes and align with the spec intent. R6 is only partially evidenced in this diff because a distinct deterministic stub mechanism is not clearly introduced.
